channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about RC Buford | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about RC Buford from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Mike Brown on RC Buford, Sam Presti
item.description:
Mike Brown:

“The first time I saw him play was when our front office, led by R.C. Buford, had us work him out at the pre-draft camp in Chicago [in 2001]. I thought he was just okay. He was fast, obviously. That stood out. But he really couldn’t shoot the ball well. He didn’t have a medium game. We had put him in through some drills, and we just didn’t know what he would bring to the table. After that first workout, the coaching staff wasn’t really that high on him. We liked him, but he didn’t have a great workout. RC Buford and Sam Presti were the ones that convinced all of us to take a second look at him.”

Mike Brown on RC Buford, Sam Presti, Aug 9, 2023. Source: SportsKeeda.

item.title: Adam Silver on RC Buford
item.description:
NBA commissioner Adam Silver on load management:

“There’s nothing more frustrating also for our fans than having players, frankly, who aren’t injured following some program schedule for rest. I’m looking at [Spurs executive] R.C. [Buford], you started this all.”

Adam Silver on RC Buford, Jul 12, 2022. Source: Twitter @BenGolliver.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on RC Buford
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Gregg Popovich on RC Buford:

“We are always on the same page. We don't have to always agree on everything.”

Gregg Popovich on RC Buford, May 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on RC Buford
item.description:
Melissa Rohlin:Gregg Popovich on RC Buford:

“We would have had a hard time keeping this together for this long if he wasn't here.”

Gregg Popovich on RC Buford, May 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.
